Employment Hero 2026: financial analysts nationally median A$120k, up to about A$149k for senior staff. Chosen current base of A$130,000 a year (A$10,833 a month); f = 10,833 / 26,000 = 0.4167. Noura's 34,000 SAR expectation maps to about A$170k, just above the Robert Half top figure, which suits a CPA-qualified 8-year analyst moving into a senior FP&A or FP&A lead role. autoText.en: Australian and New Zealand citizens can work in Australia without employer sponsorship.
autoText.ar: يحق للمواطنين الأستراليين والنيوزيلنديين العمل في أستراليا دون رعاية تأشيرة من صاحب العمل.
autoText.fr: Les citoyens australiens et néo-zélandais peuvent travailler en Australie sans parrainage d'un employeur.

rule.en: If you need sponsorship or have limited work rights, we skip Australian jobs that ask for full work rights or permanent residency and favour employers that sponsor. Without Australian citizenship, we also skip roles that require it, such as most federal public service jobs.
rule.ar: إذا كنت تحتاج إلى رعاية تأشيرة أو كانت حقوقك في العمل محدودة، نتجاوز الوظائف في أستراليا التي تشترط حقوق عمل كاملة أو إقامة دائمة، ونعطي الأولوية لجهات العمل التي تقدّم الرعاية. ولغير حاملي الجنسية الأسترالية، نتجاوز أيضاً الوظائف التي تشترطها، مثل معظم وظائف الخدمة العامة الاتحادية.
rule.fr: Si vous avez besoin d'un parrainage ou si votre droit de travailler est limité, nous écartons les offres en Australie qui exigent un droit de travail complet ou la résidence permanente, et privilégions les employeurs qui parrainent. Sans la nationalité australienne, nous écartons aussi les postes qui l'exigent, comme la plupart des emplois de la fonction publique fédérale.

sensitive.notes: Australian resumes and SEEK/ATS applications leave out photo, date of birth, marital status and nationality. The Fair Work Act 2009 (s351) and the federal Sex, Age and Racial Discrimination Acts, plus state laws such as the NSW Anti-Discrimination Act 1977, protect sex, age, race, national extraction and marital status, so employers avoid collecting them at application stage. Work rights are asked as a screening question instead (SEEK's standard 'right to work in Australia' question) and handled by the rights card. Some employer forms add a voluntary diversity section (gender, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander identity, disability) that always allows 'Prefer not to say'; it is optional, so we do not ask. Citizenship is a genuine requirement only for most federal public service and security-cleared roles, which the rights rule covers.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Sydney. I lead AASB (IFRS) reporting and the July-June budget cycle on SAP across business units and own the monthly close for a 40-person function. I built the rolling forecasts and variance analysis that cut our reporting time by a third, and I am looking for a Senior Financial Analyst or FP&A role in Sydney or hybrid.
bio.ar: محلل مالي بخبرة 8 سنوات في سيدني. أقود إعداد التقارير وفق المعايير المحاسبية الأسترالية (AASB) المتوافقة مع IFRS ودورة الموازنة للسنة المالية من يوليو إلى يونيو على نظام SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، وأتولى الإقفال الشهري لإدارة تضم 40 موظفاً. بنيتُ التوقعات المتجددة وتحليل الانحرافات التي خفّضت وقت إعداد التقارير بمقدار الثلث، وأبحث عن دور محلل مالي أول أو في التخطيط والتحليل المالي (FP&A) في سيدني أو بنظام العمل الهجين.
bio.fr: Analyste financier avec 8 ans d'expérience à Sydney. Je pilote le reporting AASB (IFRS) et le cycle budgétaire de l'exercice juillet-juin sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction de 40 personnes. J'ai mis en place les prévisions glissantes et l'analyse des écarts qui ont réduit d'un tiers notre temps de reporting, et je recherche un poste d'analyste financier senior ou en FP&A à Sydney ou en hybride.

culture.notes: Work week Mon-Fri, 38 ordinary hours under the National Employment Standards; hybrid (2-3 office days) is common for Sydney and Melbourne finance roles, though the big banks have pushed for more office days. The financial year runs 1 July to 30 June, so budget season is roughly March-June and EOFY close is a busy period for FP&A. Salaries are quoted per year, either as base + super (12% superannuation guarantee since 1 July 2025) or as a total package including super, so always say which; SEEK asks for an expected annual base salary. Pay is fortnightly or monthly. Notice is set by the contract: 4 weeks is standard for analysts, 4-8 weeks for managers (the NES minimum an employer must give is 1-4 weeks by length of service). Resumes: 2-3 pages, reverse-chronological, a short career summary at the top, no photo, date of birth, marital status or nationality; two referees (usually recent managers) are checked before an offer, and 'Referees available on request' is the usual line. A tailored cover letter is still expected by many employers and SEEK lets you attach one; public sector roles ask for a statement or 'pitch' against the selection criteria. Common screening questions: right to work, expected salary, notice period, CPA/CA status, and willingness to do a police (and for banks, credit) check. Specialist agencies (Hays, Robert Half, Michael Page, Robert Walters, Morgan McKinley) fill a large share of FP&A roles.
